event.notes: "name" is matched as a substring against ESPN's own event name (punctuation and case are ignored), and the FIRST match in the scoreboard window wins. For a one-off card "UFC 330" is unique and enough. For a weekly series it is not: ESPN lists every Contender Series week inside the 45-day lookahead, so the name must carry the season and week or the run will silently price the wrong card. Discovery pulls recent uploads from each capper channel and keeps the ones whose title matches settings.discovery.title_contains. Add entries to "videos" only to pin a specific video by hand.

Dana White's Contender Series 2026 Week 1 Predictions

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Called it a squash match and his top most confident pick — Rodriguez's explosive power striking is far too much for the outclassed grappler Miller.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Miller is stiff, awkward and easily hit despite durability; Rodriguez is a decent, physically imposing striker who can walk him down and finish, likely in round one or two.

options.selection: Douglas Rodriguez by KO in round 1

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects Rodriguez to land big shots early and finish Miller in the first round.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Rodriguez has size, power, speed and striking advantages similar to Ryan Gandra who battered Miller, but he warns not to max bet since Rodriguez is helpless off his back.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Puga is the much better boxer with body work and professional boxing experience, and although his initial takedown defense is suspect he scrambles very well back to his feet.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Puga is the crafty, slicker striker with solid takedown defense and good jiu-jitsu, so Trembly's wrestling shouldn't dominate and Puga should win the standup exchanges.

options.selection: Roman Puga by KO in round 2

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: He thinks Puga's boxing and body shots will accumulate on Tremblay and break him down in the second round.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Most confident pick and lock parlay leg: Perez has faced better competition and has solid striking plus a strong ground game, while Paxton built his record on cans.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Perez is notably faster on the feet and his grappling is strong, though Paxton's size and Perez's cardio issues are concerns.

options.selection: Christian Perez by submission in the first two rounds

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: He likes Perez's grappling after what he did to Manel Sousa early, but Perez gassed late so the finish should come in rounds one or two.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Most confident pick and lock parlay leg: Fazil's forward pressure and combinations should overwhelm Brito, who he expects to slow down and crumble, possibly by TKO or club-and-sub.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Fazil has the better submission game, a nice boxing base and high volume for three rounds; he should win if he keeps pressure and avoids fighting at Brito's distance.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: He leans toward a submission win for Fazil, likely in the second or third round, since Fazil is much more dangerous on the ground.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Thinks Barboza is done at this point and that Ribovics is very likely to win, probably by knockout.
